review_candidates.description: Er du den, der ser en M365-løsning, som kan gøres mere sikker, en proces, der kan automatiseres eller en struktur, der trænger til at blive strammet op - og tænker: “Godt, det kan jeg få styr på.” Så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig. Til Grain & Protein Technologies søger vi netop nu en erfaren Microsoft 365 Administrator, som ikke bare driver og administrerer, men som tager ansvar for, at systemlandskabet fungerer og udvikles. Grain & Protein Technologies er en global koncern, som danske Cimbria er en del af. Og det er netop hos Cimbria, du får dit fysiske kontor og din daglige gang. IT-miljøet er globalt med brugere og kolleger på tværs af blandt andet Europa, USA, APAC og Sydamerika. Derfor er det også vigtigt, at du er komfortabel med at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk. Du kommer til at arbejde med Microsoft 365 – Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint og OneDrive Entra ID, Azure og Intune Conditional Access, Defender og Identity Protection Brugere, rettigheder, licenser og policies Governance, standarder og i tæt samarbejde med compliance-teamet L2- og L3-support Fejlfinding og problemløsning på tværs af M365 og den øvrige IT-infrastruktur Automatisering og løbende forbedringer af måden, man arbejder på Derudover vil du få berøring med blandt andet Windows Server, hosting, netværk og disaster recovery. Lidt om dig Det er et krav, at du har solid erfaring med Microsoft 365-administration og L2/L3-support. Du er vant til at arbejde i en større organisation med mange brugere, gerne 500+, og tage ansvar for, at tingene fungerer på tværs. Du behøver ikke kunne sætte flueben ved alt på listen. Til gengæld skal du være teknisk stærk, kunne se sammenhænge, tage beslutninger og ejerskab - og have erfaring nok til at finde årsagen, når noget ikke fungerer, som det skal. Og så skal du kunne samarbejde med både teknikere, brugere og kolleger, der ikke nødvendigvis synes, at tekniske specifikationer er verdens mest spændende samtaleemne. Bliv en del af en varm og veletableret afdeling Du refererer direkte til den ansvarlige leder Jesper Frost . Han hører hjemme på kontoret i Thisted og supporterer over hele EMEA. I den danske IT-afdeling har du et dygtigt, fagligt fællesskab, og I er en del af et globalt hold på +50 kolleger. Du står altså ikke alene, men du skal vide, at det her er en rolle for dig, der er helt komfortabel med at have ansvar. Der er en uformel og lattermild tone på kontoret og et naturligt fokus på både personlig og professionel udvikling. Du vil opleve, at flere kollegaer har lang anciennitet i virksomheden. Det er en fordel, hvis du bor, så du kan komme på kontoret i Thisted eller Herning mandag til torsdag og arbejde hjemme fredag. Men vi ved godt, at du ikke nødvendigvis bor lige rundt om hjørnet, så der kan være mulighed for mere fleksibilitet. Ærlig talt Det her er ikke jobbet for dig, hvis du leder efter et IT-miljø, hvor alt allerede er perfekt dokumenteret, standardiseret og sat i system. For det er det ikke. Det er globalt, og det er komplekst. Men hvis du kan se forbedringsmuligheder og har erfaringen til at føre dem ud i livet, så vil vi rigtig gerne snakke med dig. Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Del gerne dit CV eller din LinkedIn-profil og svar på to spørgsmål. Har du noget, der skal afklares først, kan du altid ringe til Hanne Munk på 35 95 35 84.

review_candidates.description: OT Cybersecurity Operations Engineer Location: Cairo, Egypt At Scatec, you get to work on something that matters. We develop, build, own, and operate renewable energy solutions that accelerate access to reliable and affordable clean energy. As part of a global and agile organisation, you will work with skilled colleagues across functions and geographies, take real ownership, and contribute to a company driven by the vision of improving our future. At the heart of everything we do is our belief that we bring the energy for change, connection, and growth. It shapes how we collaborate, innovate, and create impact together. If you are looking for a role where your contribution is visible, your development matters, and your work supports a more sustainable future, Scatec may be the right place for you. Ready to make an impact? Why this role matters As OT Cybersecurity Operations Engineer, you will own the operational health of Scatec’s OT monitoring and asset-management environment. You will keep the OT asset register accurate, ensure OT networks are monitored, and drive OT security alerts, vulnerabilities, configuration drift, and incidents through to closure. This is a global role with a strong operational focus, supporting reliable monitoring, data quality, platform availability, and effective incident management across Scatec’s OT landscape. What you’ll be doing In this role, you will: Triage alerts from the OT detection platform within agreed SLAs, classify severity, assign disposition, and drive each alert through the full incident lifecycle. Separate genuine security events from process noise and provide tuning feedback to the detection platform owner. Own the OT vulnerability register by mapping CVE findings to assets, assessing exploitability in context, and assigning risk ratings. Follow up with OEMs and O&M contractors on patch availability, firmware validation, deployment windows, and closure of agreed actions. Coordinate deployment windows with site O&M teams, verify post-change status, refresh baselines, and document compensating controls where patches are not available. Support incident response by preserving evidence, providing asset and network context, and contributing to post-incident reviews. Maintain the monitoring, asset-register, and configuration-management platforms, ensuring they are available, backed up, patched, licensed, documented, and supported by tested restore procedures. Monitor platform availability, integration health, asset-register synchronisation, detection-platform exports, automated ticket creation, backup success, and data quality. Manage network monitoring elements including device groups, monitoring templates, alert rules, escalation chains, distributed monitoring proxies, and version-controlled OT device templates. Maintain asset-register data including sites, devices, interfaces, IP address space, VLANs, Purdue level, zones, and conduits. Ensure configuration backup coverage, secure credential handling, configuration-diff alerting, and firmware repository management through the configuration-management platform. Maintain a single authoritative OT asset register and ensure all other systems reconcile to it. Review discovered devices weekly, classify them as expected, OEM-introduced, or unauthorised, and escalate unauthorised assets immediately. Run monthly reconciliation across the asset register, detection platform, monitoring platform, and configuration-management platform, and drive every exception to closure. Reconcile configuration drift against approved OT change requests, refresh baselines after approved changes, support compliance evidence for IEC 62443, NIS2, and ISO 27001 controls, and contribute to monthly operational reporting. Your work will help strengthen Scatec’s OT cybersecurity operations, improve visibility across critical infrastructure, and ensure alerts, vulnerabilities, and configuration changes are managed with clear ownership and discipline. What you’ll gain Global exposure to OT cybersecurity operations across renewable energy assets. Hands-on responsibility for monitoring, asset register, vulnerability, and configuration-management processes. The opportunity to work closely with IT Operations, Cybersecurity, plant teams, EPC project teams, OEMs, and O&M contractors. A role where operational ownership, reliability, and data quality directly support secure and resilient plant operations. What you’ll bring Experience and qualifications Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Communication Networks, or a similar field. 3–5 years’ experience in network or infrastructure operations, including at least 2 years in industrial, utility, or critical-infrastructure environments. Relevant certification such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, CCNA, or similar is preferred. Familiarity with OT security frameworks and regulations such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and NIS2. Experience in security incident triage, vulnerability management, and operational follow-up until closure. Strong monitoring fundamentals, including SNMP v2c/v3, ICMP, syslog, and agent-based monitoring. Hands-on experience building monitoring templates, alert rules, and escalation chains in enterprise network monitoring systems. Solid Linux server administration and container experience, including Docker. Strong IP networking knowledge, scripting experience in Python, Bash, or PowerShell, REST API integration, DCIM/IPAM or CMDB practice, and packet/network troubleshooting skills such as Wireshark or PCAP analysis. What it’s like to work at Scatec At Scatec, we combine purpose with performance. We value responsibility, clarity, and collaboration, and we encourage people to challenge existing ways of working, contribute ideas, and keep developing. You can expect an environment where people work together across disciplines and geographies, where good performance matters, and where you are trusted to take ownership without unnecessary hierarchy. If you are passionate about OT cybersecurity operations, critical infrastructure, and building reliable monitoring and incident-management practices, this could be an exciting next step in your career. What we offer At Scatec, you will be part of a company with a clear and ambitious purpose, working on renewable energy solutions that make a lasting difference. You will gain responsibility early, learn from experienced colleagues, and build your capabilities in a business that offers global exposure, strong development opportunities, and meaningful work in the energy transition. We are continuously evolving as a digital and data-driven organisation, leveraging technology and AI to improve how we work and create value for our teams. Scatec is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, competence, and business needs. We review applications on an ongoing basis.
